vetSays.line: 🛡️ Gus, Domingo, Caitlin, Benjamin and Sofia met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gus, Domingo, Caitlin, Benjamin, Sofia are hurt.
🛡️ Benjamin, Sofia and Nina met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Benjamin, Sofia, Nina are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Domingo, Caitlin, Benjamin, Liam and Sofia met them at the door — 5 put down. Domingo, Benjamin, Liam, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Domingo just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caitlin just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Domingo, Caitlin and Sofia met them at the door — 3 put down. Domingo, Caitlin, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Diana just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoe just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Caitlin, Zoe, Sofia, Nina and Nadia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Nadia didn't come back. Zoe, Sofia, Nina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liam just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Xavier just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Xavier met them at the door — 1 put down.
🛡️ Ademar met them at the door — 1 put down. Ademar is hurt.
